name: First Steps
description: Clear the first dungeon from start to finish.

name: Into the Depths
description: Clear the second dungeon from start to finish.

name: Sanctum of Shadows
description: Clear the third dungeon from start to finish.

name: Dragon Gate Crasher
description: Clear the fourth dungeon from start to finish.

name: The Final Showdown
description: Fight your way through the earlier dungeons and reach the final dungeon.

name: Sonic Who?
description: Clear the first dungeon in under 60 seconds.

name: Run Like an Egyptian
description: Clear the second dungeon in under 90 seconds.

name: Fenrir Couldn't Catch Me
description: Clear the third dungeon in under 4 minutes.

name: Wind Fire Wheels
description: Clear the fourth dungeon in under 3 minutes.

name: Three Heads, One Victory
description: Defeat all three Cerberus heads in one encounter.

name: Serpent Slayer
description: Defeat the Snake miniboss.

name: Eight Legs, No Escape
description: Defeat Sleipnir, the eight-legged horse miniboss.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Defeat the Chinese Dragon miniboss.

name: What are those green things?
description: Defeat the Snake miniboss without collecting any green shield gems during the encounter.

name: Green bubble
description: Collect a green shield gem for the first time during Stage 2.

name: Whack-a-Mole
description: Land a damaging player attack during Snake's post-emergence pause in either stage, before the Stage 2 poison-spitting sequence begins.

name: Vanquisher
description: Reach the final dungeon and defeat the final boss.

name: I need a break too
description: Complete the full Stage 1 inter-wave break without hitting the Boss.

name: Coolin' off, make it fun
description: Hit the Boss with a player ice projectile during Stage 2.

name: I'm fireproof!
description: Complete Stage 2 without being hit by a Boss fireball.

name: Whoa! The Snow Queen
description: Be hit by an ice projectile for the first time during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: Brrr, it's freezing!
description: Be hit in three consecutive ice volleys during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: You flashed too fast
description: Land the first sword or dagger hit on the Boss during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: How can a statue even flash?
description: Trigger the first successful statue teleport during Stage 3 Wave 2.

name: You killed 3 Medusa
description: Defeat 3 Medusas.

name: Stone Cold Killer
description: Defeat 10 Medusas.

name: Sand in My Eye
description: Defeat 4 Sandeyes.

name: Mummy Issues
description: Defeat 6 Mummies.

name: Who Let the Wolves Out?
description: Defeat 8 Wolves.

name: Elf on the Shelf (Deceased)
description: Defeat 15 Dark Elves.

name: Nevermore
description: Defeat 7 Crows.

name: Long Time, No Wei
description: Defeat 15 Longwei.

name: Monkey Business
description: Defeat 4 Wukongs.

name: Hercules Called, He's Jealous
description: Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon One: Medusa, Minotaur, Harpy, Golem, Cyclops and Cerberus.

name: Monster Hunter: Dungeon Two
description: Defeat at least one of each enemy found in the second dungeon: Beetle, Crab, Wasp, Mummy and the Snake mini-boss.

name: Walk Like an Egyptian
description: Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon Two: Sandeye, Beetle, Crab, Wasp, Mummy and the Snake mini-boss.

name: Ragnarok Rookie
description: Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon Three: Wolf, Dark Elf, Crow, Knight, Jotunn and Sleipnir.

name: Journey to the West
description: Defeat at least one of each enemy in Dungeon Four: Bug, Longwei, Jingwei, Zombie, Wukong and the Dragon.

name: Boss Rush: Eat Your Heart Out
description: Defeat every boss: Cerberus, Snake, Sleipnir, Dragon and the final boss.

name: Ah! Boy You killed 5 enemies
description: Defeat 5 enemies of any type.

name: Warm-Up Round
description: Defeat 20 enemies of any type.

name: Skill Issue (Theirs)
description: Defeat 50 enemies of any type.

name: Exterminator
description: Defeat 100 enemies of any type.

name: On a Roll
description: Defeat 5 enemies in a row without taking damage. Getting hit resets your streak.

name: Untouchable
description: Defeat 10 enemies in a row without taking damage.

name: Hacker? No, Just Good.
description: Defeat 20 enemies in a row without taking damage.

name: Coin Collector
description: Collect 10 gold coins.

name: Pocket Full of Gold
description: Collect 50 gold coins.

name: Dragon's Hoard
description: Collect 100 gold coins.
